summary: FD_TC_097_No Determination | New Destination (New Contract) | APPR
title: No Determination | New Destination (New Contract) | APPR
description:
After disruption, customer was rerouted to a completely different destination than originally booked. DDS cannot assess eligibility because the original itinerary no longer matches the actual journey � the promise itinerary and actual itinerary are for different destinations. System must flag this for manual handling since the automated regime/delay logic doesn't apply when the destination itself changed.

Prerequisites:
PNR: Single passenger, 2 legs AC domestic YUL?YYZ?YVR. Leg 1 (YUL?YYZ): Operated, on time. Leg 2 (YYZ?YVR): CANCELLED. Rerouting: Customer was rebooked to YEG (Edmonton) instead of original destination YVR (Vancouver). New itinerary: YYZ?YEG. Cancellation code: CREW (Controllable). Customer claim: "I was supposed to go to Vancouver but they sent me to Edmonton."
